mapper.select: SELECT draw_row.id AS draw_record_id, draw_row.activity_id, activity_row.name AS activity_name, draw_row.result_status, winning_row.id AS winning_record_id, winning_row.activity_prize_id, activity_prize_row.prize_id, prize_row.name AS prize_name, activity_prize_row.prize_type_snapshot AS prize_type, draw_row.draw_time FROM draw_record draw_row INNER JOIN activity activity_row ON activity_row.id = draw_row.activity_id LEFT JOIN winning_record winning_row ON winning_row.draw_record_id = draw_row.id LEFT JOIN activity_prize activity_prize_row ON activity_prize_row.id = winning_row.activity_prize_id LEFT JOIN prize prize_row ON prize_row.id = activity_prize_row.prize_id WHERE draw_row.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY draw_row.draw_time DESC, draw_row.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
